title: Shine Nest Services
cardDescription: Business website for facility management and professional cleaning services with enquiry forms.
overview: A professional services website showcasing facility management, cleaning and maintenance services, with company information and business enquiries.
problem: The business needed to present many service categories clearly and capture customer enquiries.
solution: Service-category sections, a clean corporate design and easy-to-find contact forms.
result: Customers can explore services and contact the business from any device.
contributions: Built responsive layouts and UI components
